title: Thothapuri: Chapter 1
desc: A Hindu tailor and a Muslim banker, both with a witty outlook on life, fall in love. However, their differing religious beliefs create problems, testing their bond.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

title: Raambo 2
desc: Three friends drive on a road, scared by a car following and honking at them. However, when they try to get away, an exciting chase begins as the strange car follows them.

title: Akhanda 2
desc: Renowned warrior Akhanda resurfaces to confront a dangerous tantric practitioner sowing chaos. However, he is not alone in his quest for peace as his twin brother Murali Krishna joins the fight.

title: Shadow
desc: Raghuram, a journalist, exposes the criminal activities of an infamous gangster, who later murders him as revenge. Years later, Rajaram, Raghuram's son, decides to track down the killer.

title: Take It Easy
desc: Dhanraj, a middle-class man, and his family struggle to navigate through their financial issues. Soon, he sets out on a quest to buy a car despite not being able to afford it.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A priest performs sacred rituals and chants hymns, seeking blessings from the deity. The ceremony brings peace and devotion to all who witness it.

title: Ibbaru Hendira Muddina Police
desc: Due to an unexpected turn of events, an upright police officer gets married to two women. However, problems arise when he tries to juggle between his two wives.

title: A
desc: A film director fades away from the industry after the failed love with the heroine of his movie. After being rehabilitated, he learns that some people conspired his fall and decides to take revenge.
